title: Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement: Grace Period, Late Fee Assessment and Courtesy Waivers
content:
## Late fees under the Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement

**(a) Once per period.** A late fee is assessed once for a billing period when its rent is still unpaid after the grace period.

**(b) Grace period.** A parking late fee may be posted only when the handling date is later than the rent due date of the unpaid billing period plus the grace period of the class. Grace days are calendar days starting the day after the due date, and a payment on the last grace day is on time. The anchor is the due date of the unpaid period as shown on its rent charge.

**(c) Amount — no longer in force.** The former clause fixing the late fee as the greater of the flat late fee and the late-fee percentage of the monthly rent, rounded to the cent and capped at the late-fee ceiling, is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis for the late fee amount.

**(d) Standing.** Fees are posted only while the agreement stands active, delinquent, under a notice of intent to tow, under a compliance termination notice, or moving out.

## Courtesy waivers

**(e)** A courtesy waiver credits one late fee in full on request when all three of the following hold:
1. the agreement has been held at least the waiver tenure of the class, in whole calendar months;
2. no notice of intent to tow has been sent in the current delinquency cycle;
3. the number of courtesy late-fee waivers credited on the agreement in the rolling 365 days ending on the handling date (that date included, counted by the waiver's posting date) is below the courtesy waiver allowance of the class.

**(f) Billing errors — no longer in force.** The former clause that a late fee posted against a period paid within grace is a billing error credited as a billing-error correction without using the courtesy allowance is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded.

**(g) No double credit.** A charge already waived or corrected is not credited again.

### Grace boundary (hypothetical dates, 5-day grace period)

| Event | Date | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Rent due | 10 June | — |
| Grace days | 11 to 15 June | Payment on 15 June is on time |
| Earliest handling date for a late fee | 16 June | 16 June is later than 15 June; on 15 June no late fee may be posted |

### Courtesy waiver illustration (hypothetical)

An agreement held 8 whole months on a class with a 6-month waiver tenure and an allowance of 1, with no tow notice in the current cycle and no courtesy waiver posted in the last 365 days, meets all three conditions. The same agreement with a courtesy waiver posted 100 days earlier has a count of 1, which is not below the allowance of 1.

superseded_clauses: A late fee posted against a period paid within grace is a billing error and is credited as billing_error_correction without using the courtesy allowance.
The late fee is the greater of late_fee_flat_usd and late_fee_pct_of_rent times the monthly rent, rounded to the cent, capped at late_fee_max_usd.
